steps.title: Remove accessibility barriers that prevent use of the site

steps.title: Set document language and align page metadata for sharing and discovery

steps.why_now: LCP and CLS are the main performance outcomes here, and the reported resource issues are likely contributing factors. This step should follow the template and metadata work because it focuses on the shared head/body delivery path: render-blocking resources, image sizing, lazy loading, responsive image delivery, and lighter formats.

steps.title: Trim third-party payload and add caching rules
steps.why_now: These changes target the delivery layer after the main rendering path is understood. They can complement the performance work above by reducing repeated transfer and script overhead, and they fit naturally with other server and asset optimization tasks.

steps.title: Complete image and text accessibility/SEO cleanup
steps.why_now: Once the primary UX, metadata, and performance issues are addressed, the remaining content refinements can be cleaned up together because they touch the same page content and media inventory. This includes alt text, email exposure in source, and thin-content review.

steps.title: Add structured entity and content-discovery signals
steps.why_now: These are lower-priority discoverability improvements that depend on the page identity and metadata being stable first. They can be implemented after the broader content and metadata cleanup without blocking core usability.

steps.title: Add behavior analytics and revisit the oldest content after updates

groups.cluster_summary: On all 3 pages read (home, oou-services-2, about-us), the same four issues recur identically: unprotected contact forms, legacy-format images, multiple H1 headings, and an H2→H4 heading jump.

groups.cluster_summary: Across the pages checked, structured data is incomplete: only 1 of 3 pages has schema at all, the JSON-LD blocks present are not linked to each other, LocalBusiness is missing geo/openingHoursSpecification/priceRange, no sameAs entity links exist, and no BreadcrumbList is present.
groups.cause_hypothesis: The pattern of partial, disconnected, and field-incomplete structured data across the pages checked suggests schema markup was added ad hoc/incompletely rather than through a consistent, complete implementation.

groups.cluster_summary: On the oou-services-2 page, both the meta description and the og:description tag are missing.
groups.cause_hypothesis: The absence of both the meta description and og:description on the same page suggests no description content was ever entered for this page, affecting both fields at once.

groups.cluster_summary: The server has a slow median response time (1725 ms) across the pages measured, and 7 internal URLs return errors including an HTTP 429 (too many requests).
